test_title: PYST 5 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition:
His promotion was contingent ____ the outcome of the annual review.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. on .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **contingent** is often followed by the preposition "on"</strong
